hypotheses.claim: WP03 can consume the receipt-bound V18 FrontendArtifact and form typed semantic/state identities without reparsing source or reopening ClayCode surface syntax.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Full owner-directive fidelity or downstream WP04 consumption exposes a missing primitive or semantic mismatch that current typed-state fixtures do not cover.
hypotheses.falsifier: Production self.root/GWT/Hyperposition/ClayGraph/UnifiedDB directive fixtures fail exact typed lowering or downstream consumption without an untyped escape hatch.

hypotheses.claim: WP04 should remain fail-closed with explicit target+arity CallContract obligations and should admit a call only after an independently justified exact signature plus current runtime binding exists.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Caller equality constraints and target-name semantics are sufficient to infer safe concrete signatures without an independent declaration.
hypotheses.falsifier: A matched suite shows inference from caller constraints/name semantics uniquely recovers independently held-out declared signatures with zero false contracts and no effect/authority leakage; until then inference remains forbidden.

hypotheses.claim: Clay semantic/type/effect authority should remain backend-neutral; MLIR/WIT/WASI may implement lowering/runtime handles but must not become the source of Clay semantic or effect authority.
hypotheses.strongest_counterhypothesis: Delegating capability enforcement entirely to a mature sandbox backend materially simplifies Clay without loss of safety or observability.
hypotheses.falsifier: End-to-end adversarial differential demonstrates backend-only enforcement dominates ClayCode deterministic effect gates across stale/revoked/forged/cross-version capabilities and recovery while preserving semantic receipts.
